result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: the hero image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' failed to load and shows a generic broken-image placeholder. The rest of the page, including the header, search, category chips, promo banner and the 'Fastest near you' carousel, renders correctly.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a flat gray box with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant's photo. This is the most prominent card on screen and looks noticeably unfinished next to the fully illustrated cards around it.
issues.suggestion: Check the image URL, CDN availability and loading logic for this restaurant. Add a branded fallback image or cuisine illustration so a failed load doesn't show a generic broken-image icon. Consider retrying the load and caching the image.
